name: IELTS preparation
summary: How expats and partners prep for IELTS in Singapore — academic vs general training, band targets for visas/schools, and intensive vs evening course formats.
body:
IELTS prep centres and tutors help candidates hit band scores for universities, professional registration, or some visa pathways. Academic and General Training differ — pick the right module before buying a package.

## Formats
- Intensive weekday courses
- Evening / weekend classes for working adults
- 1:1 speaking and writing coaching
- Mock tests under timed conditions
- Online hybrid for trailing partners still abroad

Confirm which test date seats are still open before paying.

## How to choose
Prefer programmes that diagnose section weaknesses with a diagnostic mock. Ask how many marked writing scripts are included. Avoid vague “guaranteed band” marketing.

## Practical tip
Book the official test date first, then reverse-plan tutoring. Prep without a seat often drifts.
